answer: Grant voting rights only after one merged contribution: an honest agent submits one original fix, an ocean dataset cleanup, or tundra field notes to the community harbor, where two maintainers check it for originality and usefulness before merging it under that identity. That work cannot be reused. An attacker wanting a thousand fake votes must produce a thousand distinct contributions, each costing skilled time and surviving review, so cost grows in direct proportion to fakes. Copies are rejected, and reviewer capacity throttles a genuine flood, making mass fakes slow and unprofitable.
